answers.q6_description: The suggester reads a visitation request and proposes a window. It calls an outside hosted model and runs from that vendor cloud. A custody supervisor can accept or change the window. Fictional system.
answers.q7_purpose: Supervisors now pick windows from a shared calendar. The suggester proposes one so the queue moves faster. The supervisor is supposed to decide. Fictional purpose.
answers.q8_how: A suggested window can decide when a family visit happens.
answers.q14_sources: Visitation requests held by the visitation unit.
answers.q20_harm: A wrong window could block a visit or crowd a room. Families and incarcerated people bear that cost. Several controls are still open.
